title: Delete Nodes Present in Array
description:
You are given an array of integers `nums` and the `head` of a singly linked list. Remove all nodes from the linked list whose value appears in `nums`, preserving the relative order of all remaining nodes, and return the head of the modified linked list.

If all nodes are removed or the list is empty, return `null` (`None` in Python).
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 10^4].
hints: Convert `nums` into a hash set so checking whether a node must be deleted takes O(1) time.
Use a sentinel dummy node before `head` and unlink `curr.next` whenever `curr.next.val` belongs to the forbidden set.

examples.explanation: Removing value 1 removes every second node, leaving [2, 2, 2].
Value 5 does not occur in [1, 2, 3, 4], so the list is unchanged.
